parsed.explanation: The dossier documents a traveller-facing hostile regime: airport screening compares presentation with passport sex; 2016, 2022 and 2025 cases include hours-long detention, genital X-ray, mockery, passport confiscation, refused entry or deportation. Gender nonconformity is criminal, and older enforcement shows presentation arrests, short custodial sentences, deportation, effeminate-cell placement, head-shaving, seizure of hormones and forced medical pressure. No legal gender recognition, no LGBTQ organisations, no anti-discrimination route, and unresolved detention indicate no recourse. Same-sex criminalisation is largely a secondary climate signal given no documented prosecutions, while officials’ anti-queer rhetoric and censorship reinforce hostility. The border exposure is universal, severe but not documented execution or near-automatic long imprisonment; hence high-risk, just above the severe band.
